claims.claim: Villa Ukika is a contemporary Yagan community context near Puerto Williams.
Villa Ukika is associated with the Comunidad Indígena Yaghan de Bahía Mejillones.
Current Chilean heritage sources frame Yagan cultural continuity through practices including basketry, language transmission and ties to territory and maritory.
An authoritative canonical point geometry for Villa Ukika has not yet been established in the verified corpus.
